facets.description: addGuests.handler.ts:46-48 uses && instead of || for team admin/owner checks, wrongly denying admins who are not owners.
addGuests.handler.ts:52-54 allows any attendee matched by email to add guests, making permissions too permissive.
The FORBIDDEN message key you_do_not_have_permission at addGuests.handler.ts:55 is missing from en/common.json, potentially exposing the raw key in the toast.
